response.overview: Mercedez Has A Control Issue  Dangerous curves ahead. The lights are off and you are going 100 mph. Welcome to a night with Mercedez. Paul Thomas presents 'Out Of Control,' a tale of a woman and her quest for love and lust in another man's arms. And when a handsome new guy comes into town she finds that loving at home is rather dull. But what else would you expect from this hot little latina sex goddess. Mercedez is Out Of Control... wanna take the wheel?
response.title: Out Of Control
